description: Image Description: The image shows a compact, retro-style toaster oven placed on a gray countertop. The appliance has a two-tone design with a red front panel and a silver-gray body. It features a transparent glass door with a black handle, through which the interior is visible. Inside, there are glowing pinkish-red heating elements, indicating that the oven is powered on and actively heating. On the right side of the front panel, there are two black rotary dials, likely for temperature and timer
